overview: City Councilor Emily Lazzaro reviewed her first months in office, outlining priorities for affordable housing, infrastructure, and homeless services. She also detailed recent changes to City Council rules regarding public participation and planned community engagement efforts.

items.title: Council Procedural Changes and Rules of Order
items.summary: Discussed the implementation of a two-year governing agenda and new limits on public participation, reducing individual comment time to three minutes.

items.title: Affordable Housing and Infrastructure Priorities
items.summary: Prioritized funding the affordable housing trust for projects like Walkling Court and addressing deferred maintenance in city water and sewer systems.

items.title: Real Estate Transfer Fee Proposal
items.summary: Addressed concerns regarding a proposed real estate transfer fee, stating it targets developer profits rather than residents on fixed incomes to fund housing initiatives.

items.title: Homelessness Services and Warming Center Proposal
items.summary: Proposed establishing a seasonal warming center in Medford to provide local shelter services for unhoused adults.

items.title: Enhanced Community Engagement Methods
items.summary: Announced upcoming listening sessions and a new online form system allowing residents to submit comments for the official meeting record.
